housing: Most San Franciscans rent, often in Victorian and Edwardian flats, small apartment buildings and in-law units; many older units are covered by the city's Rent Ordinance.

localRules.text: San Francisco landlords must pay tenants interest on security deposits each year at a rate set by the Rent Board (4.2% from March 1, 2026).

tenantHelp.name: San Francisco Rent Board
tenantHelp.what: city rent board; rules on deposits and rent

climate: Check for damp, mold and condensation around windows and in closets, and test the heater; the city is cool and foggy for much of the year.
fact: In San Francisco a security deposit earns interest that the landlord must pay each year, either directly or as a credit against rent.
